newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to firmer on weather, APIs.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to firmer on weather, APIs.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to firmer across the barrel on Wednesday, traders said.
Gasoline prices were steady with barges supported by short covering while bullish API data underpinned cargoes.
Spot naphtha prices were steady to soft in quiet trade with physical demand staying relaxed, but forward paper picked up the more bullish sentiment of gasoline.
Gas oil was steady with futures only marginally weaker and premiums unchanged. Cold weather on both sides of the Atlantic give underlying short-term support.
High sulphur fuel barges gained $1 to $82/$83 on the back of better bunker demand. Some traders predicted healthy business this afternoon ahead of the Ascension day break.
